visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses wearing a green t-shirt stands at a kitchen service counter, holding a white ceramic ramen bowl and interacting with staff behind the partition. (2) Close-up shot showing yellow noodles being poured from a separate bowl into a larger bowl filled with creamy broth and toppings. (3) The man stands outside on a city sidewalk in front of a restaurant called "Xiao Song Ramen," gesturing energetically toward the sign. (4) The man is seen inside using a digital ordering kiosk with a touch screen. (5) A series of close-ups show pieces of char siu being torched with a flame and a soft-boiled egg being held in a black spoon over the ramen bowl. (6) The man sits at a wooden table, eating the noodles vigorously with chopsticks while speaking to the camera. (7) He returns to the counter to ask for more noodles, then continues eating at his table, showing the nearly empty bowl being refilled.
